FREAKETONAS is back on the decks 🔥 DJ Ralphy-Ray is loading up perreo, dembow, house and all the Latin hits that make la pista impossible to leave. This is the Friday habit Pasco didn't know it needed — vibras latinas from the first track to the last call. Bring the energy, we'll bring the sound. Mark it, tell your gente, see you on la pista. 💃🕺

Real reason FREAKETONAS hits different? The drinks match the energy 🍬🥃 We're talking Mexican candy cocktails that taste like your childhood dulcería with a kick, tequila cocktails done right, and spiked horchata that goes down way too smooth. Pair that with DJ Ralphy-Ray on perreo, dembow and house, and you've got a Friday that doesn't ask permission. No cover means zero excuses. 💋
